text: Now adapting the ref images to match the colors of the first (somewhat) gave a better result that looks more life-like. Seedance 2.0 is pretty cool, i might start creating with it more often. https://t.co/FMz2vd7plY
content: Adapt your reference images to match the color palette of the first reference image to get more life-like results in Seedance 2.0

translations.es: Adapta tus imágenes de referencia para que coincidan con la paleta de colores de la primera imagen de referencia y obtén resultados más realistas en Seedance 2.0
translations.fr: Adaptez vos images de référence pour correspondre à la palette de couleurs de la première image de référence afin d'obtenir des résultats plus réalistes dans Seedance 2.0.
translations.ja: Seedance 2.0でよりリアルな結果を得るために、参照画像を最初の参照画像のカラーパレットに合わせて調整してください。
translations.ko: Seedance 2.0에서 보다 생생한 결과를 얻기 위해 첫 번째 참고 이미지의 색상 팔레트에 맞춰 참고 이미지를 조정하세요.
translations.pt-BR: Adapte suas imagens de referência para corresponder à paleta de cores da primeira imagem de referência para obter resultados mais realistas no Seedance 2.0
translations.zh-CN: 将您的参考图像调整为与第一个参考图像的色彩调色板相匹配，以在Seedance 2.0中获得更逼真的效果。
